query:
UPDATE job_queue
         SET stage = COALESCE($5, stage),
             progress_done = COALESCE($6, progress_done),
             progress_total = COALESCE($7, progress_total),
             checkpoint = COALESCE($8::jsonb, checkpoint),
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
           AND run_number = $2
           AND attempt = $3
           AND worker_id = $4
           AND status = 'LEASED'
           AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
